scientific_integrity: The Catalan and sharp size theorems are derived analytically with exact-arithmetic finite tests for independent checks. Known general finite-bath optimization ideas and one-qubit no-injection are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The mathematical optimum assumes one arbitrary global excitation-number-conserving unitary on a pure-ground-state target and finite identical-gap Gibbs qubits; no locality, complexity, dynamical realization, work implementation cost, coherent input, or bath-interaction robustness is established. Closest recent primary preprints were accessible only through their public abstracts, leaving a stated possible-coverage risk.
title: Catalan activation law for ergotropy from a finite thermal qubit bath
